endpoint-chat.description: Endpoint live chat windows (#8743). They render technician-authored text, so they get no window, webview, tray, menu, shell or emit permission and not core:default: the window calls only its own label-checked app commands (get_chat_view, chat_send_reply, chat_mark_read), and every privileged app command refuses a chat-* caller (deny_message_window). The one thing it needs beyond that is to listen for its own chat-updated event (core:event:allow-listen / allow-unlisten); Rust emits that event to this window's label only.

message-card.description: Endpoint message card windows (#8293). They render technician-authored text, so they get no window, webview, event, tray or menu permission: the card only calls its own label-checked app commands, and every privileged app command refuses a message-* caller (deny_message_window). core:app:allow-version is a harmless read that keeps the capability non-empty.
